Protection for Outdoor Unit The supplier must provide and install a protective mesh/net at the backside of each AC outdoor unit. This mesh should be durable and sized appropriately to prevent entry of birds, rodents, and reptiles, thereby sh ielding internal components and ensuring uninterrupted operation. 8. No Additional Copper Pipe Charges No further or hidden charges shall be applicable for copper pipes, irrespective of price variation in the mar ket. 9. Service Support After-sales service and maintenance support must be provided by the supplier or authorized service agenc y for the warranty period. .
